question: In the game of Basketball, each basket shall consist of a pressure-release NBA approved metal safety ring ______ in inside diameter with a white cord net 18” in length.
solution:
The correct answer is __**18"**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In basketball, the standard diameter of the basketball hoop is **18 inches**.
 
• The diameter of the hoop is measured from the inside edge of the rim to the opposite inside edge.
 
• This standard size is maintained in all NBA-approved games to ensure uniformity and fairness in play.
 
• The hoop is made of a pressure-release metal safety ring to enhance durability and safety during gameplay.
 
• The net attached to the hoop is **18 inches in length**, aligning with the diameter of the hoop for consistency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball Backboard**

 
 
• The backboard is typically made of tempered glass, which offers a consistent rebound.
 
• The standard dimensions of a basketball backboard are 72 inches in width and 42 inches in height.
 
• The backboard provides a target for bank shots and protects the hoop from being easily damaged.
 
 
 
• **Basketball Court Dimensions**
 
 
• The standard size of a basketball court is 94 feet in length and 50 feet in width for NBA games.
 
• The free-throw line is 15 feet away from the backboard.
 
• The three-point line distance varies: 23.75 feet from the basket at the top of the key and 22 feet in the corners for NBA.
 
 
 
• **Basketball Sizes**
 
 
• A regulation basketball for men's professional play has a circumference of 29.5 inches.
 
• For women's professional play, the basketball has a circumference of 28.5 inches.
 
• Youths typically use smaller basketballs, with sizes appropriate for their age group to ensure proper handling and shooting techniques.
 
 
 
• **NBA Standards**
 
 
• The NBA specifies stringent standards for all equipment used in the game, including the hoop, backboard, and ball.
 
• These standards ensure a high level of consistency and quality in gameplay across all official matches.
 
• All equipment used must be approved by the NBA to maintain uniformity and safety for players.
